what: Observational model: log10 OBIS species richness per 2-degree cell from NCEI microplastics, OBIS sampling effort, latitude, NOAA CRW SST and DHW
interpretation_note: Association only (not causation). Negative direction = higher microplastic concentration associated with fewer recorded species after controls.

sources.microplastics: NOAA NCEI Marine Microplastics Database - Ocean Surface (Professional Science)
sources.temperature_heat_stress: NOAA Coral Reef Watch 5km daily (12 monthly snapshots)
